## Overview

Species-level names in **`r taxon`** (genus) whose **type specimens were collected in
Brazil** - according to the type specimens that fungaria worldwide publish through the
[Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)](https://www.gbif.org) - were compared
against the current [Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB)](https://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/consulta/)
checklist. A type collected in Brazil is direct evidence that the taxon occurs in the
country, so each name below is a candidate for inclusion in the FFB monograph of its group.

Names are compared by their GBIF *accepted* name as well as the name itself, since GBIF
and FFB occasionally disagree on which genus a species belongs to. Orthographic variants
(case, hyphens, *-ii*/*-i* endings) are treated as the same name.

`r if (!is.null(d$source)) paste0("**Data source:** ", d$source, ".")`

```{r kpi-boxes}
kpi_boxes <- list(
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-gold",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", comma(d$n_typed)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        paste0("Species-level names in ", taxon,
                               " with Brazilian type specimens"))
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-green",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", comma(d$n_in_ffb)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label", "Species of the genus registered in FFB")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-red",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", comma(d$n_missing)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label", "Missing from FFB")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-amber",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value", comma(d$n_specimens)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label", "Brazilian type specimens of the missing names")
  )
)

do.call(htmltools::tags$div, c(class = "kpi-row", kpi_boxes))
```

## Species with Brazilian Type Specimens Missing from FFB

The table below lists all `r comma(d$n_missing)` species-level names in **`r taxon`**
with type specimens collected in Brazil that are not currently in FFB, with a summary
of those specimens and a link to the name's GBIF page.
Use the column filters to narrow the list, and the buttons above the table to copy or
download it as CSV/Excel.

```{r table-missing}
tbl <- d$result

if ("GBIF_URL" %in% names(tbl)) {
  tbl$GBIF_URL <- ifelse(
    !is.na(tbl$GBIF_URL) & nzchar(tbl$GBIF_URL),
    paste0('<a href="', tbl$GBIF_URL, '" target="_blank">', tbl$GBIF_URL, '</a>'),
    ""
  )
}

DT::datatable(
  tbl,
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
  extensions = c("Buttons"),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
    paste0("Table 1. All ", comma(d$n_missing),
           " species of ", taxon, " with Brazilian type specimens missing from FFB.")
  ),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 20,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    scrollX = TRUE,
    search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
    lengthMenu = list(c(10, 20, 50, 100, -1),
                      c("10", "20", "50", "100", "All"))
  )
)
```
